clips.speaker: Howard Marks
clips.title: 橡树资本马克斯：美联储少说话，市场反而更安全？
title_lines: 美联储沟通与市场韧性
少一点指引，多一点安全？

subtitles.en: Well, I actually think that less communication is better.
subtitles.zh: 其实我认为，少一些沟通反而更好。

subtitles.en: I'm not looking for the Fed Chair to tell me what to do, or even tell me what he's going to do.
subtitles.zh: 我并不指望美联储主席告诉我该怎么做，甚至不指望他告诉我他打算做什么。

subtitles.en: But I think that to the extent that the central banker tells people less about what he's going to do,
subtitles.zh: 但我认为，央行官员越少透露他打算做什么，

subtitles.en: they have to make their portfolios and their businesses anti-fragile, which is better for society.
subtitles.zh: 人们就越需要让自己的组合和业务具备抗脆弱性，这对社会更有利。

subtitles.en: When everybody in society thinks they know exactly what the Fed's going to do and prepares for that,
subtitles.zh: 当社会中的每个人都以为自己确切知道美联储会怎么做并据此准备时，

subtitles.en: then the society is dependent on that outcome. And if something else happens, then bad things can happen.
subtitles.zh: 整个社会就会依赖那个结果。一旦出现别的情况，就可能发生糟糕的事情。

subtitles.en: So I think it reads, I think it adds to safety in the environment overall.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，这总体上增加了环境的安全性。

clips.speaker: Howard Marks
clips.title: 橡树资本马克斯：乐观主导市场，估值已偏高？
title_lines: 乐观主导时，该不该谨慎？

subtitles.en: Well, look, I am what's called the value investor, not with the capital V, but a small V.
subtitles.zh: 你看，我算是所谓的价值型配置者，不是大写V的那种，而是小写v。

subtitles.en: And that means our approach is to figure out the intrinsic value of an asset
subtitles.zh: 这意味着我们的方法是弄清一项资产的内在价值，

subtitles.en: and see if we can buy it at a fair price relative to that value.
subtitles.zh: 看看能否以相对于该价值的合理价格买入。

subtitles.en: The challenge today is that, in my opinion, since roughly October the 1st of 22,
subtitles.zh: 今天的挑战在于，在我看来，自2022年10月1日前后以来，

subtitles.en: I believe that the markets have been generally ruled by optimists.
subtitles.zh: 我认为市场总体上一直被乐观者主导。

subtitles.en: And the S&P has more than doubled in that period. It's been a very strong period.
subtitles.zh: 标普在此期间上涨超过一倍，是一段非常强劲的时期。

subtitles.en: And I think that you have to recognize that when the optimist rule prices tend to be high relative to intrinsic value,
subtitles.zh: 我认为你必须认识到，当乐观者主导时，价格往往相对于内在价值偏高，

subtitles.en: which means that it's a time for a little bit of caution. It's not the worst thing I've ever seen,
subtitles.zh: 这意味着现在需要一点谨慎。这不是我见过的最糟糕的情况，

subtitles.en: but I do think it's important to note that the optimists have been in control.
subtitles.zh: 但我确实认为，重要的是要指出乐观者一直占据主导。

clips.speaker: Howard Marks
clips.title: 马克斯2009年后：没真正糟糕过，所以人们外推顺境？

subtitles.en: Well, that's a great question.
subtitles.zh: 这是个很好的问题。

subtitles.en: But I think there are certain underlying truths which are positive, which are in the ascendancy.
subtitles.zh: 但我认为有一些积极的底层事实正在占据上风。

subtitles.en: Our economy is doing pretty well in the aggregates. It is, in my opinion, the best performing developed world economy.
subtitles.zh: 我们的经济总体表现相当不错。在我看来，它是表现最好的发达经济体。

subtitles.en: So, the old Tina trade, there is no alternative. And there is the excitement over AI.
subtitles.zh: 所以，老一套的TINA逻辑——别无选择。再加上对AI的兴奋。

subtitles.en: And so the optimism is just coming from the quote. And the other thing is that, you know,
subtitles.zh: 所以乐观情绪就来自这些。另外还有一点，

subtitles.en: we haven't really had a really bad time since March of 2009 when the stock market bottomed during the global financial crisis.
subtitles.zh: 自2009年3月市场在全球金融压力中见底以来，我们还没有真正经历过非常糟糕的时期。

subtitles.en: And so people get used to good times and they extrapolate good times. And that contributes to the optimism.
subtitles.zh: 于是人们习惯了顺境，并把顺境外推。这助长了乐观情绪。

subtitles.en: Well, I think that the sentient human being has to think about these things, has to acknowledge there's nothing we can do about it.
subtitles.zh: 我认为有感知力的人必须思考这些事情，必须承认我们对此无能为力。

subtitles.en: And when I reach that point in my own process, I kind of let it go, because my wife defines worrying as bleeding before you're shot.
subtitles.zh: 当我在自己的思考过程中走到这一步，我就放下了，因为我妻子把担忧定义为中枪之前先流血。

subtitles.en: And in this case, there's nothing we can do about it. Nothing's certainly nothing I can do about it personally. So you roll with it.
subtitles.zh: 在这种情况下，我们无能为力。就我个人而言，肯定什么都做不了。所以只能顺势而为。

subtitles.en: That's all. You acknowledge it. You let people think about it. But it should not be a preoccupation, am I?
subtitles.zh: 就这样。你承认它，让人们去思考它。但它不应该成为执念，对吧？

subtitles.en: Are you satisfied people are thinking about it enough or in the right way? Well, people are. On the other hand, I don't see anything out of government.
subtitles.zh: 你满意人们思考得足够多或方式正确吗？人们在思考。但另一方面，我没看到政府有什么动作。

subtitles.en: You know, I think there should be a task force on the effect of the coming effect of AI. And there isn't.
subtitles.zh: 我认为应该有一个关于AI即将带来的影响的工作组。但现在没有。

subtitles.en: Now, when they form the task force, I don't know what they can do about it. But it might be nice to think about it.
subtitles.zh: 等他们成立工作组时，我不知道他们能做什么。但思考一下总是好的。

subtitles.en: And if you want one little task to work on, how about this? If people are put out of work, they won't pay taxes. If AI takes their place as workers, will it take their place as taxpayers and how?
subtitles.zh: 如果你想找一个小的任务来研究，这个怎么样？如果人们失业，他们就不会交税。如果AI取代他们成为劳动者，它会取代他们成为纳税人吗？怎么取代？

subtitles.en: So what will happen to government revenues when and if people lose their jobs?
subtitles.zh: 那么，当人们失去工作时，政府收入会发生什么变化？

clips.speaker: Howard Marks
clips.title: 橡树资本马克斯：AI有泡沫吗？没人能下定论
title_lines: 是理性繁荣还是非理性？

subtitles.en: Well, the main thing is, as I wrote in the last memo on the subject, Alan Greenspan used the phrase in 97. I think it was irrational exuberance.
subtitles.zh: 主要的一点是，正如我在上一篇相关备忘录中写的，格林斯潘在97年用过这个词。我想是“非理性繁荣”。

subtitles.en: And that is the definition of a bubble. We certainly have exuberance. The question is whether it's irrational.
subtitles.zh: 这就是泡沫的定义。我们当然有繁荣。问题是它是否非理性。

subtitles.en: And since nobody, in my opinion, can spec out exactly what it is that AI's been going to be doing and with what effect and with what profitability, I don't think anybody can say that it's irrational.
subtitles.zh: 在我看来，既然没有人能准确推断出AI究竟会做什么、带来什么影响、有多大的盈利能力，我认为没人能说它就是非理性的。

subtitles.en: But you have to consider the possibility. And so when you tackle AI from an investment point of view,
subtitles.zh: 但你必须考虑这种可能性。所以当你从配置角度看待AI时，

subtitles.en: you have to think about how confident you are in your judgments.
subtitles.zh: 你必须思考你对自己的判断有多大信心。

subtitles.en: And how much, like in everything else, but taken to a higher power, we have to think about how important is us to make all the money that's going to be made by the most aggressive people?
subtitles.zh: 而且，就像在其他事情上一样，但程度更高，我们必须思考：去赚那些最激进的人将要赚的所有钱，对我们有多重要？

subtitles.en: And are we willing to take on the uncertainty, which is associated with that?
subtitles.zh: 我们是否愿意承担与之相关的不确定性？

clips.speaker: Badr Mohammed Al-Meer
clips.title: 卡塔尔航空CEO：未来五年接收138架飞机，如何平衡波音空客？

subtitles.en: So that way allows us to, hey, you need to maintain your slots. You need to maintain your loyal customer base. As a result, we still have a pretty resilient picture just because it's demand-driven. And people still want to travel.
subtitles.zh: 这样一来，我们就能保持时刻资源，保持忠诚客户群。因此，我们仍然有相当有韧性的图景，因为这是需求驱动的。人们仍然想旅行。

subtitles.en: You talked at the beginning, just about new routes that you're opening up. And it makes me wonder about your fleet, and it's really what you're adding to it. I know that just a few weeks into the job you made a trip to France, you went to Airbus.
subtitles.zh: 你一开始谈到了你们正在开通的新航线。这让我想到你们的机队，以及你们真正在增加什么。我知道你上任几周后就去了法国，去了空客。

subtitles.en: How are you thinking about expansion of the fleet and that balance between Boeing and Airbus, which you and every CEO has to kind of consider at the same age? In the next five years, we're set to receive about 138 aircraft.
subtitles.zh: 你如何考虑机队扩张以及波音和空客之间的平衡，这是你和每位CEO都必须考虑的？未来五年，我们将接收约138架飞机。

subtitles.en: 138? Yeah, about 50% of them are going to be Airbus and the rest of it is Boeing. So our fleet's composition is going to be 787s, 777-9s, 8350-1000s, which we are the world's largest operator of those wide-body aircraft.
subtitles.zh: 138架？是的，其中约50%将是空客，其余是波音。所以我们的机队构成将是787、777-9、A350-1000，我们是这些宽体飞机的全球最大运营商。
en_highlights: 50% of them are going to be Airbus

subtitles.en: And we're going to recently add the new long-range 831s by the end of the year. They're going to go into service in the beginning of next year. So the combination of that gives us the ability to be agile, to pivot accordingly, and also optimize with our cargo business.
subtitles.zh: 我们将在年底前新增新的远程A321。它们将在明年初投入服务。所以这些组合让我们有能力保持敏捷，相应调整，并优化我们的货运业务。

subtitles.en: We are the single largest carrier of international cargo in the world, with about 12% global market share. So we're optimizing that from a freighter cargo perspective and a belly perspective. And cargo has been roaring from a demand perspective, especially this.
subtitles.zh: 我们是全球最大的国际货运承运人，约占全球市场份额的12%。所以我们从全货机和腹舱角度进行优化。从需求角度看，货运一直非常旺盛，尤其是今年。
zh_highlights: 全球最大的国际货运承运人

subtitles.en: So they're roaring, I see, they're roaring. Floating, sorry. But you're planning for our cargo is important for you. Cargo is incredibly important. We're set to double down on our business. Agnostic of all we've seen with the straight explosion.
subtitles.zh: 所以它们在旺盛，我明白了，它们在旺盛。抱歉，是浮动。但你们对货运的规划对你们很重要。货运极其重要。我们准备加倍投入我们的业务。不管我们在海峡爆发中看到什么。

subtitles.en: We've seen demand pick up from the energy transition perspective, from the semiconductor boom, from all the funds that are going into all the capital that's flowing into AI. And as a result, our passengers are actually picking up that airways cargo to transport their goods to services in global.
subtitles.zh: 我们看到需求从能源转型、半导体繁荣、以及所有流入人工智能的资本中回升。因此，我们的旅客实际上正在使用航空货运将他们的货物运往全球服务。

subtitles.en: Have you seen an uptake in that part of the business, given that that is one of the few remaining ways to get things out if you can't ship them through the straight reliably? 100%.
subtitles.zh: 鉴于如果无法可靠地通过海峡运输，这是少数剩余的运输方式之一，你们是否看到这部分业务的增长？100%。
en_highlights: uptake in that part of the business

clips.speaker: Badr Mohammed Al-Meer
clips.title: 卡塔尔航空CEO：货运需求爆发，如何抓住AI与半导体机遇？
title_lines: 如何抓住AI与半导体机遇？

subtitles.en: We saw in the beginning of the conflict where cargo basically shipped everything from produced berries to essential goods and services into the home market. But at the same time, it is a massive hub, and it's set to grow.
subtitles.zh: 我们在冲突初期看到，货运基本上把所有东西从生产的浆果到基本商品和服务运往本土市场。但与此同时，这是一个巨大的枢纽，而且注定会增长。

subtitles.en: And that hedge, in that sense, from a cargo business, really gives Qatar and Qatar, and Qatar, anyways, that flexibility to menu recording. But we're also looking at cargo from a customer side of things.
subtitles.zh: 从货运业务的角度看，这种对冲确实给了卡塔尔航空灵活性。但我们也在从客户角度看待货运。

subtitles.en: We're learning from the passenger business to adopt things into the slightly more archaic old-fashioned cargo business. Our customers are actually choosing us because we're treating them like they should be in the 2026.
subtitles.zh: 我们正在向客运业务学习，将一些做法引入稍微更古老、更传统的货运业务中。我们的客户实际上选择我们，是因为我们以2026年应有的方式对待他们。

subtitles.en: We started off. Christina talking about the Q-suite. You guys off-camber talking about the mint tea, all of the amenities. Yes. Qatar always is literally the reason I obsessively drink mint tea now.
subtitles.zh: 我们开始。克里斯蒂娜谈到了Q-suite。你们在非正式场合谈论薄荷茶，所有设施。是的。卡塔尔航空正是我现在痴迷喝薄荷茶的原因。

subtitles.en: Let me close by asking you about Starlink. Because I just flew a flight on another airline that had Starlink, and it's revelatory. It is so much faster. What is your deal that you have with Starlink and how important is it to get that into all the planes that you're flying?
subtitles.zh: 让我最后问一下Starlink。因为我刚乘坐了另一家航空公司的航班，有Starlink，这具有启示性。它快得多。你们与Starlink的协议是什么，将其安装到所有飞机上有多重要？

subtitles.en: So we are the single largest operator of a Starlink fleet, or a Starlink equipped fleet. We just recently equipped our 787-9s with Starlink. We banded a little bit with our team on the technical side of things.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们是最大的Starlink机队运营商，或者说配备Starlink的机队。我们最近刚为787-9配备了Starlink。我们在技术方面与团队进行了一些合作。
en_highlights: largest operator of a Starlink fleet

subtitles.en: Because right now they're able to install Starlink in about three to four hours on an aircraft, which is basically the envy of other airlines coming. Okay. What are you guys doing with Starlink? How are you guys deploying it so fast?
subtitles.zh: 因为现在他们能够在约三到四小时内在一架飞机上安装Starlink，这基本上是其他航空公司羡慕的。好的。你们用Starlink做什么？你们如何如此快速地部署？

subtitles.en: We've learned, we've trailblazed the Starlink product. It has been a stellar selling point from, you know, you're on the 18 hour flight to Auckland. You know, you definitely take advantage of high speed Wi-Fi. That's incredible. Amazing.
subtitles.zh: 我们学到了，我们开创了Starlink产品。它一直是一个出色的卖点，你知道，在飞往奥克兰的18小时航班上。你知道，你肯定会利用高速Wi-Fi。那太不可思议了。太棒了。

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
